description: A standing decimal scale stays live through coercion, fractional powers, overflow, underflow, NaN and recovery
code:
power = 2
scale = Math.exp10(power)
assert(scale, 100)
power = 3
assert(scale, 1000)
power = -1
assert(scale, 0.1)
power = 0
assert(scale, 1)
power = "2"
assert(scale, 100)
power = -2
assert(scale, 0.01)
power = 1.5
assert(scale, Math.pow(10, power))
power = 309
assert(scale, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
power = -400
assert(scale, 0)
power = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
assert(scale, 0)
power = Number.NaN
assert(String(scale), "NaN")
power = 3
assert(scale, 1000)
scale
